# Original purpose: closed-loop metrics, S/envelope, T, output and control step response
reports={}
for name,C in [('old_ms',K_ms),('old_ls',K_ls),('candidate',candidate())]:
    v=audit(C);reports[name]={key:value for key,value in v.items() if key not in ['S','T','U']};print(name,reports[name])
v=audit(candidate());peaks=full_peaks();S,T,U,stack=response()
print('default_full_peaks',peaks,'sample_peak',max(abs(S)),'sample_gamma',max(stack),'u_initial',2.,'error_final',0.)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(10,6));ax[0,0].semilogx(w,abs(S),label='S');ax[0,0].semilogx(w,1/abs(W1(1j*w)),ls='--',label='1/W1');ax[0,1].semilogx(w,abs(T),label='T')
_,y=ctrl.step_response(v['T'],t);_,u=ctrl.step_response(v['U'],t);ax[1,0].plot(t,y,label='output');ax[1,1].plot(t,u,label='control')
for a in ax.flat:a.grid(True);a.legend()
ax[0,0].set_xlabel('rad/s');ax[0,1].set_xlabel('rad/s');ax[1,0].set_xlabel('seconds');ax[1,1].set_xlabel('seconds')
print('step_sample_ymax_umax',max(y),max(abs(u)),'T10',abs(v['T'](10j)))
plt.tight_layout();plt.show();print('design_complete')

# Original comparison purpose retained as failure audit, not a claim of algorithm superiority
fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(10,6))
for name,C in [('old_ms_unstable',K_ms),('old_ls_unstable',K_ls),('fixed_family',candidate())]:
    v=audit(C);short=np.linspace(0,1,501);_,yy=ctrl.step_response(v['T'],short);_,uu=ctrl.step_response(v['U'],short)
    ax[0,0].plot(short,yy,label=name);ax[0,1].plot(short,uu,label=name)
    ax[1,0].semilogx(w,abs(v['S'](1j*w)),label=name);ax[1,1].semilogx(w,abs(v['T'](1j*w)),label=name)
for a in ax.flat:a.grid(True);a.legend(fontsize=7)
ax[0,0].set_title('Finite-time output: unstable traces have no final-value claim');ax[0,1].set_title('Finite-time control')
plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
misalignment=[]
for wn in [9.,10.,11.]:
    v=audit(candidate(),wn);row={key:value for key,value in v.items() if key not in ['S','T','U']};misalignment.append((wn,row));print('fixed_K_plant_wn',wn,row)
print('comparison_complete')
